newsitem.title: UK: Albert Fisher appoints England chief exec.
newsitem.headline: Albert Fisher appoints England chief exec.

text.p: Albert Fisher Group Plc said on Monday it had appointed Neil England chief executive. He will join the company in November.
The food processing and distribution group said Stephen Walls will remain executive chairman of the group.
England, who is currently vice president of Mars Inc. based in Moscow, will be responsible for operations in the UK, Europe and North America.
"The timing of his appointment will allow an effective transition with Tim Howden," said executive chairman Walls.
Howden is currently chief executive of the European division and retires in April, 1997.
